item: One database package, and the source manager tests open their file with the app's pragmas (row 285)
summary: tests/test_source_manager.py was the only importer of the bare database. path (through a src/ sys.path entry), which loaded a second copy of the package beside src.database with its own Base and module state; it now imports src.database and a guard scans src, tests and scripts for the bare path (static imports and import_module strings). tests/_app_engine.py gives a test's own SQLite file the app's connect listener (foreign keys, WAL, busy timeout); the source manager fixture uses it and asserts foreign_keys is on. Measured for the wider ask: forcing foreign keys on for every test engine adds 162 failures and 11 setup errors in 33 files, every one a test seeding a child row with no parent, no app cascade failing; 610 of 639 engine-building test files skip the app's pragmas; per Plan's ruling a one-way ratchet holds the 824 create_engine calls in those files from growing (new tests use app_sqlite_engine) and row 288 converts them in batches. Test-only, no release line.
